subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words/phrase.

An extra profit or allowance additional to a main income etc
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 3, Perquisite'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase describes an extra benefit or profit that is received in addition to the main income, which is commonly known as a 'Perquisite' in English.(वेतन के अतिरिक्त लाभ).
 
• Example: The use of a company car is a perquisite of the job.
 
• 'Perquisite' is a special right or privilege that comes with a job. It’s an added benefit over and above the salary.(वेतन के अतिरिक्त लाभ).
 
• Example: Free meals at work is a perquisite many employees enjoy.

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 3, Perquisite'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Perplexity' (उलझन) refers to a state of confusion or bafflement.
 
• 'Persecute' (उत्पीड़न करना) means to subject someone to hostility and ill-treatment
 
• 'Persevere' (दृढ़ता से कार्य करना) denotes persistence in doing something despite difficulties or delay in achieving success.
